name: curio-bridge
description: Curio's MCP server: the kernel's tools for Claude, and the channel that carries the reader's requests into the learner's Claude Code session.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/curio-mcp.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
